Name: Pufferchick Scarecrow
Author: Fynzou
Description:
Simple Mod that replaces the default Scarecrow with the SMAPI Mascot, the Pufferchick! Guaranteed to scare more crows away than ever before!*

To Install:

Step 1: Download the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]﻿.
Step 2: Download the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿.
Step 3: Unzip into [b]Stardew Valley/Mods[/b].
Step 4. Run the game and Enjoy! 

[size=1]*claims not verified.[/size]
